scope: Aggregate structural statistics of Control Switch -> Amp switch modifier bindings serialised by the FM3 (FW13) in one user-owned commercial tonepack. No preset files, names or values are stored here; the pack stays on the user's machine.
method: Each preset decoded with scripts/fm3-modifier-audit.mjs; active records whose source is Control Switch 1..6 and whose target is amp DISTORT_BOOST/BRIGHT/CUT/FAT/SATSWITCH compared word for word with the default template.
crossCheck: references/fm3-volume-binding-evidence.json: the user's own FM3-created External 1 -> Volume binding has the same template words 1..7 and 10..24.
notProven: device import, STORE and reload of a newly written binding
switch behaviour on the front panel
Control Switch type/default state (not part of the record)
inverted, partial or channel-limited forms (seen but not written)
